name: Hokenshitsu no Tokubetsu Jugyou! Chiisana Yuutousei Idol no Yowami o Nigitte H na Itazura Shichau Hen
original_name: 保健室のトクベツ授業! 小さな優等生アイドルの弱みを握ってHなイタズラしちゃう編
source:
The second game in the Hokenshitsu no Tokubetsu Jugyou! series is a story about a public health health doctor who has sex with a junior idol.

"The serious and honor student heroine was actually a loli girl idol! As a condition to protect her secret, I will play naughty pranks on her every day!"
translation:
《保健室的特别课程！》系列的第二部作品，讲述了一位保健医生与少女偶像发生性关系的故事。

“认真的优等生女主角竟然是一名萝莉偶像！作为保守她秘密的条件，我每天都要对她进行色情恶作剧！”
